policy: No angular-proximity-only deduplication. Ambiguous combined/component photometry is withheld rather than added. Catalogue inventory and rendered emission are distinct.
limitations: Not a complete census of physical multiplicity.
No guessed component fluxes, binary orbits, variable-star phases or photometric corrections.
Some retained representatives may be component-only: conservative withholding can be too faint. Raw measurements remain available for later source adjudication.
